hashKind: Git blob object identity, not SHA-256

sources.decision: Actual Nitro v1 contracts and owned Qt/JS lifetime; no invented platform codegen.
Separate source, host, cross-build, actual shell and physical evidence.
Specify caller behavior, failures, ready resources and cleanup before native implementation.
Reproducible generated/native contracts and runtime behavior; adapt older examples to actual v1 policy.
RAII, explicit owner contexts, no callback under locks or hidden blocking UI work.
Measure the real interaction and target; mobile-specific tools do not prove QNX support.
Preserve exact-run artifact identity and failure output; do not reuse mobile builds as target proof.
Verify standalone packed consumers and generated file contents; do not copy a mobile TurboModule scaffold into QNX.
Require literal prerequisite-aware consumer walkthroughs later; not applied as a style rule to internal phase RFCs.
Explicit module platform metadata and actual native implementation; discovery is not runtime registration or a native port.

conditionalSelections: Expo Router/navigation: discover exact available skill source and pin before navigation implementation.
Expo/RN upgrade or API2 migration: verify exact skill/source and compatibility before changing versions.
Margelo networking/MMKV: verify exact path, version and target-native support before that service implementation.
Swift/Kotlin: only for actual Apple/Android code changes, not QNX/Linux C++ by default.
Trusted code review, no-ai-slop and everything-claude-code: verify installed source and relevant scope before claiming use.
Qt/Wayland/QNX/Marathon source audits: primary technical sources, not invented installed skills.
